responsibility: Defines the IA-64 OpenVMS subtarget configuration, including VMS preprocessor builtins, assembler and linker specs, startup files, object-format and debug conventions, library-function naming, constructor emission, pointer and mode-promotion rules, case-vector mode, and stack-check settings. It adapts the generic IA-64 backend to VMS runtime and toolchain requirements, including VMS-specific DWARF handling and restrictions such as limited COMDAT support.
same_name_distinction: The OpenVMS subtarget header for IA-64: unlike vms.opt, which only adds VMS-specific command-line options, this file overrides backend macros and specs for the VMS environment, such as builtins, startup/link/assembler specs, debug handling, promotion rules, pointer/case-vector modes, and COMDAT support.
